notes: Phase 1: disease pack pins are real and hash-verified. raptor_commit pins the exact code/pack implementation commit (Commit A of the code-review remediation) this Discovery context targets -- never the metadata-only commit that sets this pin itself, which would be self-referential and impossible to compute in advance. atlas_schema_version pins the authoritative Mechanism Atlas starter spec schema id, not the disease-pack manifest schema id. prompt_hash and packet_manifest_hash are explicit Phase-2 placeholders -- no real Discovery run has produced a prompt or packet manifest yet.
